description: This file defines the ExecApprovalManager class for managing approval records, including creation, registration, resolution, expiration, and lookup functionalities, with associated types and constants.

classes.name: ExecApprovalManager
classes.description: Manages approval records with methods for creation, registration, resolution, expiration, and lookup.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new approval record with a unique ID and timestamps.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an approval record and returns a promise that resolves upon decision.

methods.name: waitForDecision
methods.description: Deprecated method to wait for a decision on an approval record.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves an approval record with a decision and cleans up.

methods.name: expire
methods.description: Expires an approval record if no decision has been made.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current state of an approval record.

methods.name: consumeAllowOnce
methods.description: Consumes a one-time 'allow-once' decision to prevent replay.

methods.name: awaitDecision
methods.description: Returns a promise for the decision if pending, or null if not.

methods.name: lookupPendingId
methods.description: Looks up pending approval IDs by exact match or prefix.
